back_translation: Hear the word that the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.
The LORD says this: Do not learn the way of the nations, and do not be terrified by the signs in the sky, even though the nations are terrified by them.
For the customs of the peoples are worthless; they cut down a tree from the forest, and a craftsman shapes it with an axe.
They adorn it with silver and gold, and fasten it firm with nails and hammers so that it will not totter.
Those idols are like a scarecrow in a cucumber field; they cannot speak; they must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm, and neither can they do any good.
O LORD, there is none like You; You are great, and Your name is great in power.
O King of nations, who would not fear You? For that fear is Your due; for among all the wise of the nations and in all their kingdoms there is none like You.
But they are all alike senseless and foolish; the instruction of worthless idols is only wood.
Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of a craftsman and of a goldsmith's hands; the idols' clothing is blue and purple, all the work of skilled men.
But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and the eternal King. When He is angry, the earth quakes, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.
Thus you shall say to them: The gods that did not make the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth and from under these heavens.
The LORD, who made the earth by His power, who established the world by His wisdom, and who stretched out the heavens by His understanding —
When He utters His voice, the waters in the heavens roar; He makes the clouds rise from the ends of the earth; He makes lightning for the rain and brings the wind out of His storehouses.
Everyone is senseless, without knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idol, for his cast image is a lie, and there is no breath in them.
They are worthless, a work to be laughed at; in the time of their punishment they will perish.
The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance; the LORD of Hosts is His name.
O you who dwell under siege, gather up your belongings from this land.
For the LORD says this: Behold, this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land like a stone from a sling, and I will bring distress on them, that they may feel it.
Woe to me because of my brokenness! My wound is grievous. But I said, 'This is truly my sickness, and I must bear it.'
My tent is destroyed, and all my ropes are snapped. My children have gone out from me and are no more; there is no one left to pitch my tent or to set up my curtains.
For the shepherds of the people have become senseless, and they did not seek the LORD; therefore they did not prosper, and all their flock is scattered.
Listen! A sound of a report is coming, and a great commotion from the land of the north, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a haunt of jackals.
O LORD, I know that a man's way does not belong to himself; the one who walks cannot direct his own steps.
O LORD, correct me, but only with justice — not in Your anger — lest You diminish me to nothing.
Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not know You, and on the clans that do not call on Your name, for they have devoured Jacob, consumed him completely, and laid waste his homeland.
